def transform(g):
 h=len(g); out=[]
 for i in range(3*h):
  # sequence reflected endpoints: indices h-1..0, 0..h-1, h-1..0
  idxs=list(range(h-1,-1,-1))+list(range(h))+list(range(h-1,-1,-1))
  row=g[idxs[i]]
  out.append(row[::-1]+row)
 return out
out=transform(grid)
